summary: Core AI Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Sonali Garg to its Advisory Board. The filing is a routine disclosure of a board-level advisory appointment, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is involved. The appointment follows a previously announced strategic joint venture but does not itself constitute a special situation. Accordingly, this is classified as None.
